profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer (Salesforce) at T-Mobile | 5× Salesforce Certified
profile.summary: Lead Software Engineer with 7+ years experience designing, developing, and delivering scalable enterprise solutions. Skilled in full-stack development, system architecture, and complex integrations across diverse platforms. Proven leader in mentoring teams, managing full SDLC, and architecting secure, high-performance applications. 5× Salesforce Certified, with expertise spanning Apex, Lightning, and modern software engineering best practices.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer (Salesforce)
positions.description:
• Lead design and development of retail frontline applications delivering customized Salesforce solutions that ensure scalability, security and optimal performance.
• Architect automation and integration solutions using Flows, Process Builder, Apex, Visualforce and Salesforce Web Services API, along with third-party integration tools and REST/SOAP APIs.
• Drive full SDLC delivery from requirements to deployment; enforce Salesforce best practices and governance.
• Mentor and lead a team of developers, conducting design reviews and providing technical direction.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into secure, maintainable Salesforce solutions.

positions.title: Python/Salesforce Developer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
• Develop custom code using Visualforce, APEX, Java and other technologies to build customized applications for preventing duplicates, enriching the salesforce.com data and cleaning out SFDC fields (Number 1 App on Salesforce AppExchange)
• Prevent Real-Time duplication of records in the salesforce organization by adding new features to the existing salesforce application and debugging the code to increase the efficiency of the application thereby solving customer issues using APEX, dynamic Visualforce and frontend technologies
• Provide innovative solutions leveraging Salesforce’s Force.com capabilities and make recommendations to support a rapidly increasing org
• Implement best practices by developing, refining, iterating, testing, staging and deploying maintainable technical solutions to pass AppExchange security for all the above salesforce.com application

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description: Student Graduate Assistant to the Provost and Vice President for Academic Affairs at Stevens Institute of Technology

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
Research Work on Eye-Tracking, Natural Language Processing  (Python Machine Learning Libraries)
Research Project: Measuring Cognitive Load during Text Reading and Annotation using Eye-tracking
Measured the degree of difficulty perceived during reading or annotation by using state-of-the-art eye-tracking technology. Eye-movement data for multiple human readers for the tasks of paragraph comprehemsion and sentiment annotation was collected and analysed by Natural Language Processing approach

projects.title: Internet of Things (Raspberry pi, Python)
projects.description:
Implemented Weather Station, Location and Temperature Application in Python using the Django REST Framework
Connected Raspberry Pi to Particle Cloud that can read sensors, drive motors and communicate with other devices, linked with the Tinker Mobile App
Performed data analysis on the RMS Titanic training data set using Numpy, matplotlib for prediciting the  survival rate based on gender, class, age, cabin and fare

projects.title: eCommerce Website
projects.description:
Designed an eCommerce website using the Hostgator web hosting provider with the basic e-commerce pages needed for the website using WordPress
Used the WooCommerce plugin for creating the online store and selling of products and Stripe plugin for accepting credit card payments, Google Analytics to the website using the Google Search Console for monitoring the site’s presence on the Google Search results, Nelio A/B testing plugin for defining and keeping track of A/B testing experiments, Yoast SEO plugin for keyword optimization and on-site SEO needs and SEM for cross-sectional statistical modeling techniques and promote website in paid and organic search listings
